# diskcache_oxide

> A shared, durable disk cache for Python, with a Rust engine, SQLite storage, and a diskcache-compatible API.

## Why choose it

Measured against the defunct python-diskcache 5.6.3 (last release August 2023), same machine, same session:

- A cached `get` in 0.76 µs at p50 (0.42× diskcache), a `set` in 22.6 µs (0.77×), on Python 3.14; the free-threaded build is within a few percent. See [Performance](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/user-guide/performance.html).
- Eight threads sharing one `Cache` at a 99:1 read:write mix: about 650,000 operations a second, flat from 1 to 8 threads, where diskcache falls from 406,000 to 19,000 (Apple M5 Pro, Python 3.14 with the GIL; `bench/results/macos/gate-3.14.txt`). See the chart on the [home page](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/).
- Eight worker processes writing to a `FanoutCache(shards=8)`: about 1.5 million operations a second, against 262,000 for a plain `Cache` and 1.24 million for diskcache's own `FanoutCache`. See [FanoutCache](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/user-guide/fanoutcache.html).
- A prefix scan over 400,000 keys in about 10 ms, against about 25 seconds in diskcache, because `iterkeys(prefix=)` is an indexed range scan. See [Getting started](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/user-guide/getting-started.html#list-keys).
- Beyond speed: safe across `fork()` and on free-threaded CPython, no pickle on disk unless asked for, bounded connections, memory and write-ahead log, and three diskcache bugs fixed (`clear()` losing concurrent writes, `expire()` leaving entries behind, spurious misses during an overwrite). See [Divergences](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/user-guide/divergences.html).

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Cache
> Disk-backed cache backed by SQLite, shared safely across threads and processes.

- [Cache](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.html): A disk cache backed by SQLite, shared safely across threads and processes

#### Cache Methods
> Methods for the Cache class

- [Cache.directory](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.directory.html): The directory the cache is in: the one given to the constructor, or its
- [Cache.timeout](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.timeout.html): Seconds a call waits for a lock or a pending fork before raising `Timeout`
- [Cache.size_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.size_limit.html): The disk budget in bytes. A `set()` that finds the cache over it evicts entries
- [Cache.cull_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.cull_limit.html): The most entries a single `set()` evicts when the cache is over `size_limit`
- [Cache.eviction_policy](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.eviction_policy.html): `'least-recently-stored'` or `'none'`, as this handle last saw it stored (at open or its
- [Cache.enabled](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.enabled.html): Always True for a real cache; False for a `NullCache`
- [Cache.set](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.set.html): Store `value` under `key`, replacing any existing value
- [Cache.add](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.add.html): Store `value` only if `key` is missing or expired
- [Cache.delete](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.delete.html): Remove `key`
- [Cache.touch](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.touch.html): Change the expiry of an existing entry without rewriting its value
- [Cache.incr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.incr.html): Add `delta` to the number stored under `key`, atomically, and return the result
- [Cache.decr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.decr.html): Subtract `delta` from the number stored under `key`, atomically. See `incr()`
- [Cache.memoize](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.memoize.html): Return a decorator that caches the function's results in this cache, as diskcache's `memoize`
- [Cache.remove_old_formats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.remove_old_formats.html): Remove the caches an older diskcache-oxide format left in this cache's directory: the
- [Cache.check](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.check.html): Check the database and the value files against each other, as diskcache's `check()`
- [Cache.stats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.stats.html): `(hits, misses)` of `get` and `cache[key]` in this process, as diskcache's `stats()`
- [Cache.durable](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.durable.html): True for a `durable=True` handle
- [Cache.__reversed__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__reversed__.html): Keys in insertion order backwards, newest first (a `FanoutCache`: the last shard first)
- [Cache.expire](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.expire.html): Remove every expired entry, and its value file
- [Cache.clear](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.clear.html): Remove every entry that existed when the call started
- [Cache.evict](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.evict.html): Remove every entry tagged `tag` that existed when the call started
- [Cache.cull](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.cull.html): Remove expired entries, then evict the least recently stored until under `size_limit`
- [Cache.volume](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.volume.html): The cache's size on disk in bytes: the database plus value files
- [Cache.checkpoint](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.checkpoint.html): Copy the write-ahead log into the database and truncate it to zero
- [Cache.close](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.close.html): Close this handle and return its connections
- [Cache.pull](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.pull.html): Remove and return the item at `side` of a queue, as diskcache's `pull`
- [Cache.peek](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.peek.html): The item at `side` of a queue, without removing it, as diskcache's `peek`
- [Cache.peekitem](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.peekitem.html): The newest entry (or with `last=False`, the oldest) of any key, without removing it, as
- [Cache.transact](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.transact.html): A write transaction, for `with cache.transact() as tx:`
- [Cache.__getitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__getitem__.html): `cache[key]`: the value, or `KeyError` if it's missing or expired, or the read failed under
- [Cache.__setitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__setitem__.html): `cache[key] = value`: store a value that never expires, like `set()`. Under `durable=True` a failed write is
- [Cache.__delitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__delitem__.html): `del cache[key]`: remove the entry, or raise `KeyError` if it's missing or expired, or the delete failed
- [Cache.__contains__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__contains__.html): `key in cache`: True if the key holds a live (unexpired) value. False if the check failed under
- [Cache.__len__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__len__.html): The number of entries, including expired entries not yet removed
- [Cache.__bool__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__bool__.html): Always True, even when empty, so `if cache:` means "caching is on"
- [Cache.__iter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__iter__.html): Iterate over keys in insertion order. An overwrite keeps its key's place
- [Cache.__enter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__enter__.html): Return the cache, for `with Cache(...) as cache:`
- [Cache.__exit__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.__exit__.html): Close the cache, as `close()` does
- [Cache.get](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.get.html): Return the value stored for `key`, or `default` if it's missing or expired
- [Cache.pop](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.pop.html): Remove `key` and return its value, delivering it to exactly one caller
- [Cache.reset](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.reset.html): Read `size_limit`, `cull_limit` or `eviction_policy` as stored now, or persist a new value and
- [Cache.iterkeys](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.iterkeys.html): Iterate over keys in sorted order, optionally only those starting with `prefix`
- [Cache.push](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Cache.push.html): Push `value` onto a queue and return its key, as diskcache's `push`

#### FanoutCache
> A cache sharded over several SQLite databases, so writers in many processes stop queueing on one write lock.

- [FanoutCache](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.html): A disk cache split over several SQLite databases (shards), so reads and writes on different keys

#### FanoutCache Methods
> Methods for the FanoutCache class

- [FanoutCache.directory](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.directory.html): The root directory: the one given to the constructor, or its
- [FanoutCache.timeout](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.timeout.html): Seconds a call waits for a lock or a pending fork before raising `Timeout`
- [FanoutCache.shards](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.shards.html): How many shards the root has
- [FanoutCache.size_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.size_limit.html): The disk budget in bytes: the sum of every shard's
- [FanoutCache.cull_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.cull_limit.html): The most entries a single `set()` evicts from its shard when that shard is over its share
- [FanoutCache.eviction_policy](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.eviction_policy.html): Shard 0's eviction policy, as for `cull_limit`
- [FanoutCache.enabled](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.enabled.html): Always True for a real cache; False for a `NullCache`
- [FanoutCache.shard_of](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.shard_of.html): The shard `key` lives in, from 0 to `shards - 1`: the same in every process and release
- [FanoutCache.transact](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.transact.html): A write transaction on the shard `key` lives in, for `with cache.transact(key='total') as tx:`
- [FanoutCache.set](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.set.html): As `Cache.set`, on the key's shard
- [FanoutCache.add](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.add.html): As `Cache.add`, on the key's shard: atomic across threads and processes
- [FanoutCache.delete](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.delete.html): As `Cache.delete`, on the key's shard
- [FanoutCache.touch](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.touch.html): As `Cache.touch`, on the key's shard
- [FanoutCache.incr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.incr.html): As `Cache.incr`, on the key's shard: atomic across threads and processes
- [FanoutCache.decr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.decr.html): As `Cache.decr`, on the key's shard
- [FanoutCache.volume](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.volume.html): The total disk use in bytes of every shard (databases plus value files)
- [FanoutCache.expire](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.expire.html): Remove every expired entry from every shard, and its value file, as `Cache.expire` does
- [FanoutCache.clear](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.clear.html): Remove every entry that existed when the call started, from every shard
- [FanoutCache.evict](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.evict.html): Remove every entry tagged `tag` that existed when the call started, from every shard, as
- [FanoutCache.cull](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.cull.html): Remove expired entries, then evict the least recently stored from each shard until it's
- [FanoutCache.checkpoint](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.checkpoint.html): Checkpoint every shard's write-ahead log and truncate it to zero, as `Cache.checkpoint` does
- [FanoutCache.memoize](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.memoize.html): Return a decorator that caches the function's results in this cache, as diskcache's `memoize`
- [FanoutCache.remove_old_formats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.remove_old_formats.html): As `Cache.remove_old_formats()`, for this cache's root directory: an older format's
- [FanoutCache.check](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.check.html): Check the database and the value files against each other, as diskcache's `check()`
- [FanoutCache.stats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.stats.html): `(hits, misses)` of `get` and `cache[key]` in this process, as diskcache's `stats()`
- [FanoutCache.durable](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.durable.html): True for a `durable=True` handle
- [FanoutCache.__reversed__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__reversed__.html): Keys in insertion order backwards, newest first (a `FanoutCache`: the last shard first)
- [FanoutCache.__iter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__iter__.html): Iterate over every key once: shard 0's in insertion order, then shard 1's, and so on
- [FanoutCache.close](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.close.html): Close this handle on every shard, as `Cache.close()` does for one
- [FanoutCache.__getitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__getitem__.html): `cache[key]`, as on `Cache`
- [FanoutCache.__setitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__setitem__.html): `cache[key] = value`, as on `Cache`
- [FanoutCache.__delitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__delitem__.html): `del cache[key]`, as on `Cache`
- [FanoutCache.__contains__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__contains__.html): `key in cache`, as on `Cache`
- [FanoutCache.__len__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__len__.html): The number of entries in every shard, including expired entries not yet removed
- [FanoutCache.__bool__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__bool__.html): Always True, even when empty, so `if cache:` means "caching is on"
- [FanoutCache.__enter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__enter__.html): Return the cache, for `with FanoutCache(...) as cache:`
- [FanoutCache.__exit__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.__exit__.html): Close the cache, as `close()` does
- [FanoutCache.get](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.get.html): As `Cache.get`, on the key's shard
- [FanoutCache.pop](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.pop.html): As `Cache.pop`, on the key's shard
- [FanoutCache.reset](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.reset.html): Read `size_limit`, `cull_limit` or `eviction_policy` as stored now, or persist a new value and
- [FanoutCache.iterkeys](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FanoutCache.iterkeys.html): Iterate over keys in sorted order, optionally only those starting with `prefix`

#### NullCache
> Switched-off cache behaving as if every entry expires instantly.

- [NullCache](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.html): A switched-off cache, so app code needs no `if cache is None` checks
- [CacheLike](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.html): What application code can rely on from a `Cache`, a `FanoutCache` or a `NullCache`
- [TransactionalCacheLike](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/TransactionalCacheLike.html): A `CacheLike` with `transact()` and the queue calls (`push`, `pull`, `peek`, `peekitem`), which
- [ShardedCacheLike](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/ShardedCacheLike.html): A `CacheLike` with a sharded cache's `transact(*, key, retry=False)`, which `FanoutCache` and

#### NullCache Methods
> Methods for the NullCache class

- [NullCache.__repr__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__repr__.html): Shows the directory and any `invalidate=` cache
- [NullCache.directory](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.directory.html): The directory passed to the constructor, or None. Nothing is created there
- [NullCache.timeout](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.timeout.html): The timeout passed to the constructor (default 60). Unused
- [NullCache.size_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.size_limit.html): The size limit passed to the constructor (default 1 GiB). Unused
- [NullCache.cull_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.cull_limit.html): The cull limit passed to the constructor (default 10). Unused
- [NullCache.eviction_policy](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.eviction_policy.html): The eviction policy passed to the constructor (default 'least-recently-stored'). Unused
- [NullCache.enabled](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.enabled.html): Always False: caching is off
- [NullCache.durable](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.durable.html): Always False: a `NullCache` has no outages to answer
- [NullCache.check](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.check.html): Always `[]`: there is nothing to check
- [NullCache.remove_old_formats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.remove_old_formats.html): Always `[]`: a `NullCache` has no directory to clean up
- [NullCache.stats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.stats.html): Always `(0, 0)`: nothing is looked up
- [NullCache.reset](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.reset.html): Read `size_limit`, `cull_limit` or `eviction_policy`, or set it (checked as `Cache` checks it)
- [NullCache.get](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.get.html): Return `default`, as every entry has already expired. With `expire_time=True` or `tag=True`,
- [NullCache.__getitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__getitem__.html): Always raises `KeyError`, as every entry has already expired
- [NullCache.__contains__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__contains__.html): Always False
- [NullCache.__len__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__len__.html): Always 0
- [NullCache.__bool__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__bool__.html): Always False, so `if cache:` means "caching is on"
- [NullCache.__iter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__iter__.html): Yields nothing
- [NullCache.__reversed__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__reversed__.html): Yields nothing
- [NullCache.volume](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.volume.html): Always 0: a `NullCache` uses no disk
- [NullCache.checkpoint](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.checkpoint.html): Always True: there is no write-ahead log to reset
- [NullCache.set](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.set.html): Return True without storing anything: the write succeeds, then expires instantly
- [NullCache.__setitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__setitem__.html): Store nothing, as `set()` does
- [NullCache.add](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.add.html): Return True without storing anything: the key is always absent, so the add succeeds
- [NullCache.touch](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.touch.html): Always False: the key never exists
- [NullCache.incr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.incr.html): Return `default + delta`, since every count starts again from `default`
- [NullCache.decr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.decr.html): Return `default - delta`. See `incr()`
- [NullCache.delete](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.delete.html): False, or with `invalidate=`, delete the key from that cache and return its result
- [NullCache.__delitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__delitem__.html): Raise `KeyError`, or with `invalidate=`, delete the key from that cache
- [NullCache.pop](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.pop.html): Return `default`, shaped as `get()` returns it. With `invalidate=`, also delete the key from
- [NullCache.push](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.push.html): Store nothing and return the key an empty queue's first item gets: the item expires the instant
- [NullCache.pull](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.pull.html): Return `default` (widened as `Cache.pull` widens it): the queue is always empty. Never forwarded
- [NullCache.peek](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.peek.html): Return `default`, as `pull` does
- [NullCache.peekitem](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.peekitem.html): Raise `KeyError`: the cache is always empty
- [NullCache.clear](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.clear.html): 0, or with `invalidate=`, clear that cache (passing `timeout` on) and return its count
- [NullCache.evict](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.evict.html): 0, or with `invalidate=`, evict `tag` from that cache (passing `timeout` on) and return its
- [NullCache.memoize](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.memoize.html): As `Cache.memoize`, but every call runs the function, as every entry has already expired. The
- [NullCache.iterkeys](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.iterkeys.html): Yield nothing, or with `invalidate=`, that cache's keys, so list-then-delete still works
- [NullCache.transact](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.transact.html): A no-op context manager that yields this `NullCache`
- [NullCache.expire](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.expire.html): Always 0
- [NullCache.cull](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.cull.html): Always 0
- [NullCache.close](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.close.html): Do nothing. An `invalidate=` cache is never closed: it belongs to whoever created it
- [NullCache.__enter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__enter__.html): Return the cache, for `with NullCache() as cache:`
- [NullCache.__exit__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/NullCache.__exit__.html): Do nothing, as `close()` does

#### CacheLike Methods
> Methods for the CacheLike class

- [CacheLike.directory](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.directory.html): The cache directory (None for a `NullCache` created without one)
- [CacheLike.timeout](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.timeout.html): Seconds a write waits for another process's lock before raising `Timeout`
- [CacheLike.size_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.size_limit.html): The disk budget in bytes
- [CacheLike.cull_limit](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.cull_limit.html): The most entries one `set()` evicts when over `size_limit`
- [CacheLike.eviction_policy](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.eviction_policy.html): `'least-recently-stored'` or `'none'`
- [CacheLike.enabled](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.enabled.html): True if caching is on (`Cache`), False if it's off (`NullCache`)
- [CacheLike.get](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.get.html): Return the value for `key`, or `default` if it's missing or expired
- [CacheLike.set](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.set.html): Store `value` under `key`, with an optional expiry in seconds
- [CacheLike.add](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.add.html): Store `value` only if `key` is missing or expired. True if it was stored
- [CacheLike.delete](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.delete.html): Remove `key`. True if a live entry was removed
- [CacheLike.pop](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.pop.html): Remove `key` and return its value, or `default`
- [CacheLike.touch](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.touch.html): Change an existing entry's expiry. True if the entry existed
- [CacheLike.incr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.incr.html): Add `delta` to the number under `key`, atomically, and return the result
- [CacheLike.decr](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.decr.html): Subtract `delta` from the number under `key`, atomically, and return the result
- [CacheLike.durable](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.durable.html): True for a `durable=True` handle (always False on a `NullCache`)
- [CacheLike.check](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.check.html): Check the database and value files against each other; `[]` on a `NullCache`
- [CacheLike.remove_old_formats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.remove_old_formats.html): Remove caches an older format left in this cache's directory; `[]` on a `NullCache`
- [CacheLike.stats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.stats.html): `(hits, misses)` of `get` in this process; `(0, 0)` on a `NullCache`
- [CacheLike.reset](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.reset.html): Read or set `size_limit`, `cull_limit` or `eviction_policy`
- [CacheLike.__reversed__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__reversed__.html): Keys in insertion order backwards, newest first
- [CacheLike.memoize](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.memoize.html): A decorator caching a function's results in this cache (diskcache's `memoize`)
- [CacheLike.iterkeys](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.iterkeys.html): Iterate over keys in sorted order, optionally only those starting with `prefix`
- [CacheLike.expire](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.expire.html): Remove every expired entry. Returns how many were removed
- [CacheLike.clear](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.clear.html): Remove every entry that existed when the call started. Returns how many
- [CacheLike.evict](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.evict.html): Remove every entry tagged `tag` that existed when the call started. Returns how many
- [CacheLike.cull](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.cull.html): Remove expired entries, then evict until under `size_limit`. Returns how many
- [CacheLike.volume](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.volume.html): The size on disk in bytes
- [CacheLike.checkpoint](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.checkpoint.html): Empty the write-ahead log. True if it was reset, False if other processes kept it busy
- [CacheLike.close](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.close.html): Close this handle and return its connections
- [CacheLike.__getitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__getitem__.html): `cache[key]`: the value, or `KeyError` if it's missing or expired
- [CacheLike.__setitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__setitem__.html): `cache[key] = value`: store a value that never expires
- [CacheLike.__delitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__delitem__.html): `del cache[key]`: remove the entry, or raise `KeyError`
- [CacheLike.__contains__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__contains__.html): `key in cache`: True if the key holds a live value
- [CacheLike.__len__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__len__.html): The number of entries
- [CacheLike.__bool__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__bool__.html): True if caching is on, so `if cache:` reads naturally
- [CacheLike.__iter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__iter__.html): Iterate over every key once. A `Cache` yields them in insertion order
- [CacheLike.__enter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__enter__.html): Return the cache, for use in a `with` block
- [CacheLike.__exit__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheLike.__exit__.html): Close the cache

#### Caches
> A registry of named caches under one base directory.

- [Caches](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.html): A registry of named caches under one base directory
- [CacheStats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CacheStats.html): One cache's numbers, for an admin page. `error` says why it couldn't be read, if it couldn't

#### Caches Methods
> Methods for the Caches class

- [Caches.__repr__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.__repr__.html): Shows the base directory and the registered names
- [Caches.register](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.register.html): Register a cache. Nothing opens until its first lookup
- [Caches.__contains__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.__contains__.html): Whether `name` is registered
- [Caches.__iter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.__iter__.html): The registered names, in registration order
- [Caches.__len__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.__len__.html): How many caches are registered
- [Caches.directory](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.directory.html): The directory the named cache is registered at. After a format change the cache itself
- [Caches.__getitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.__getitem__.html): The named plain cache: opened on first use, then the same object every time
- [Caches.fanout](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.fanout.html): The named sharded cache (one registered with `shards=`), looked up as `caches[name]` is
- [Caches.disable](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.disable.html): Later lookups of these caches return `NullCache(invalidate=real)`
- [Caches.enable](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.enable.html): Later lookups of these caches return the real cache again
- [Caches.enabled](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.enabled.html): Whether lookups of this cache return the real one (it may still fail to open)
- [Caches.stats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.stats.html): Count and volume for every registered cache, opening each one. Never raises for a cache
- [Caches.clear](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.clear.html): Clear the real cache, even while it's disabled. Returns how many entries were removed
- [Caches.expire_all](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.expire_all.html): Remove expired entries from every cache. Returns how many each removed, or None for a
- [Caches.remove_old_formats](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.remove_old_formats.html): Run `remove_old_formats()` on every registered cache, opening each one, even while it's
- [Caches.close_all](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.close_all.html): Close every opened cache and forget it; a later lookup opens it again
- [Caches.__enter__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.__enter__.html): Return the registry, for `with Caches(...) as caches:`
- [Caches.__exit__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Caches.__exit__.html): Close every opened cache, as `close_all()` does

#### Errors
> Exceptions raised by cache operations.

- [Timeout](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/Timeout.html): A lock stayed held, or a fork stayed pending, for longer than the cache's timeout
- [TransactionBusy](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/TransactionBusy.html): A thread holding one cache's transaction couldn't begin another's, because another thread holds its write
- [UnsafeValueError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/UnsafeValueError.html): A pickle=False cache read a value that was stored with pickle
- [CorruptValueError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/CorruptValueError.html): A stored value couldn't be decoded: an unknown mode, or bytes that don't parse
- [ForeignValueError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/ForeignValueError.html): A stored value this build can't read but another might: an unknown mode, tag or extension (a newer version wrote
- [FormatMismatchError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/FormatMismatchError.html): A database or manifest in a format this version doesn't support, where opening the cache's
- [LayoutMismatchError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/LayoutMismatchError.html): The directory's layout doesn't match how it was opened: a plain `Cache` on a `FanoutCache` root or shard, a

#### SQLite and System
> Information about the bundled SQLite and environment.

- [sqlite_version](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/sqlite_version.html): The SQLite version reported at runtime by `sqlite3_libversion()`
- [sqlite_compile_options](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/sqlite_compile_options.html): The compile-time options of the linked SQLite (`PRAGMA compile_options`)
- [BUNDLED_SQLITE_VERSION](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/reference/BUNDLED_SQLITE_VERSION.html): The SQLite version compiled into this build, as a string

### Recipes

- [Using the cache from asyncio](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/asyncio.html): Read inline, write off the loop, and keep transactions on one thread: the three rules for FastAPI, Starlette, aiohttp and friends
- [Caching expensive calls](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/caching-expensive-calls.html): The cache-aside pattern, and memoize, a decorator that caches a function's results
- [Caching responses from other services](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/caching-http-responses.html): Cache what an upstream API returns, honor its max-age, revalidate with ETags, and keep serving the last good answer when it's down
- [Counting things](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/counters.html): View counts, download totals and usage quotas with incr() and decr(), shared by every worker and flushed to the database without losing a count
- [Storing your own types](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/custom-types.html): UUIDs, enums, timedeltas, Paths, Pydantic models and dataclasses in the cache with register_type(), and no pickle
- [Invalidating groups of keys](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/invalidating-groups.html): Clear everything cached for one user or one object: by key prefix, by tag, or by generation number
- [Watching a cache in production](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/monitoring.html): A health check and an admin endpoint for a cache: entries, bytes on disk, hit ratio, the size limit, the write-ahead log, check() for damage, and the log lines worth alerting on
- [Rate limiting](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/rate-limiting.html): Fixed-window request limits shared by every worker on the machine, with add() and incr()
- [Running a job once across workers](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/run-once.html): Use add() to make sure only one worker process runs a scheduled job
- [Server-side sessions](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/sessions.html): Sessions every worker can read, with a sliding idle timeout from touch(), an absolute lifetime, and log-out-everywhere by key prefix
- [Single-use keys](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/single-use-keys.html): One-time codes, reset links and idempotency keys: pop() hands a value to exactly one caller, and add() accepts a key exactly once
- [Serving stale values while refreshing](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/stale-while-revalidate.html): Give an entry a freshness deadline shorter than its expiry, so readers never wait for a recompute and only one worker does it
- [Testing code that uses a cache](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/testing.html): pytest fixtures for a real cache, a NullCache, and a fake clock for testing expiry
- [Upgrading across a format change](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/upgrading.html): What happens when a release changes the on-disk format: the new release opens a cache of its own in a versioned subdirectory, old and new workers run side by side, and remove_old_formats() cleans up once the old workers are gone
- [Sharing a cache across web workers](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/web-workers.html): Directory, startup, request-path timeouts and shutdown for gunicorn, uvicorn, FastAPI, Flask, Django and Celery
- [Work queues](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/diskcache-oxide/recipes/work-queues.html): A queue every worker on the machine shares: push() at one end, pull() from the other, each item delivered to exactly one worker, with no Redis
